paraphrase: Substance (dravya) is characterized by existence; it is conjoined with origination, destruction and permanence; it is the substrate of qualities and modes.
speaker: Kundakunda
notes: Cf. Tattvārthasūtra 5.29–30 ('sad dravya-lakṣaṇam', 'utpāda-vyaya-dhrauvya-yuktaṃ sat'); verse number moderate confidence.

paraphrase: A substance can be described in seven ways according to the respect intended: in some respect it is, is not, is and is not, is inexpressible, is and is inexpressible, is not and is inexpressible, is, is not and is inexpressible.
speaker: Kundakunda
notes: One of the earliest statements of the seven predications; verse number moderate confidence.
